summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for ILUMYA (tildrakizumab, BLA761067). The FDA multi-discipline review states in Section 8 that the Agency held no Advisory Committee Meeting because the safety profile was expected to be comparable to that of other approved biologics for this indication, and a separate filing-review question confirms an AC meeting was deemed unnecessary. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
